summary.result: The effects of cross sectional shapes are reported and some typical mode shapes are also presented.
summary.background: The main purpose of this paper is to present both the natural frequencies and mode shapes of tapered beams under tensile axial force.
summary.method: The Runge-Kutta method and Determinant Search method are used to perform the integration of the differential equation and to determine the natural frequencies, respectively.
